name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 18 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 18 hours starting 2026-05-21, at wavelengths from 1.34 to 4.57 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
